Ultra-Sharp Precision Cutting

Forged from premium high-carbon stainless steel, these blades are engineered to maintain a razor-sharp edge significantly longer than standard steel. This professional-grade material is the top choice for chefs because it provides superior edge retention during repetitive tasks. From mincing garlic to spatchcocking chicken, Farberware ensures effortless meal prep with tools that stay sharper, longer.

Ergonomic Comfort & Perfectly Weighted Balance

Designed for the marathon home cook, each knife features a contoured satin-finish handle that fits securely in your hand to reduce fatigue. These knives are perfectly weighted to provide maximum control and safety during heavy-duty kitchen tasks. Whether you're slicing through tough root vegetables or performing delicate herb mincing, the ergonomic design ensures a professional experience every time.

Space-Saving Organization & Iconic Durability

Keep your kitchen organized with our sophisticated black pinewood block, designed to protect your blades while maximizing counter space. As the #1 selling cutlery brand in the U.S., Farberware combines professional performance with a modern aesthetic that fits perfectly in any home, from college apartments to high-end kitchens. To ensure a lifetime of reliable use, simply hand wash and dry immediately to preserve the integrity of the high-carbon steel.

  • Versatile Design: Sleek black finish complements any kitchen decor.
  • Safe Storage: Protects blade edges from dulling while not in use.
  • Trusted Quality: The #1 chosen cutlery brand for American families.

Product Description

Professional Performance for the Home Chef

The Farberware 15-Piece High-Carbon Stainless Steel Kitchen Knife Set is the premium solution for home cooks seeking professional-level performance and durability. This comprehensive collection is designed to provide a perfect balance of variety and sharpness for every kitchen task. Each blade is expertly stamped from high-carbon steel—a material preferred for its ability to hold a sharper edge through repetitive, heavy-duty tasks like trimming meat, mincing garlic, or precision vegetable work.

Versatility for Every Culinary Challenge

Beyond the professional-grade blades, this set serves as a complete culinary starter kit. Whether you are setting up your first kitchen, looking for a thoughtful housewarming gift, or upgrading a mismatched collection, this 15-piece set covers every base. The collection features specialized tools including an 8-inch chef knife, bread knife, 4.5-inch Santoku, and six serrated steak knives for family dinners. Every tool is designed with a satin-finish ergonomic handle that fits securely in your hand, providing a comfortable, non-slip grip that reduces fatigue and ensures safety during long prep sessions.

Designed for Longevity and Organization

Modern kitchen organization is simplified with the included black pinewood block, which keeps your cutlery protected and organized while adding a modern aesthetic to your countertop. This makes it an ideal choice for wedding registries, college apartments, or new beginnings. As the #1 selling cutlery brand in the U.S., Farberware builds these knives to last; simply hand wash and dry to maintain the integrity of the high-carbon steel for a lifetime of reliable use. This set combines high-performance tools with functional design to ensure a high-quality experience for any home cook.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    So I have had this set since November 2020 - 3 FULL YEARS - and it still looks and performs like the day I first got them!! They are beautiful, sharp, feel good in the hand/nice weight and handle, and are easy to use. JUST TAKE CARE OF THEM AND HAND WASH THESE KNIVES!!     I've had these for almost 3 years now. They're "decent" if you catch them on sale at $20. ONLY if you have the talent and means to resharpen them occasionally. They are fairly sharp when new but lose the edge quickly. "Razor" sharp? NO WAY! The cheap steel has a limit on how sharp they can be sharpened, and they don't hold the edge very long, before needing resharpened. The scissors are pretty cheap. The handles are hollow, so they have to be dried almost vertically, or you'll get water dripping when you put them in the block. A couple handles have dents, possibly from dishes being set on them in the sink? I have only recently started trying them in the dishwasher, so far, no issues. They're holding up ok, with no sign of rust or spotting. I gave my daughter my much old, much larger set of "decent" Farberwear knives when I ordered these. Wish I'd waited til they arrived, she would've gotten this new set. The block is solid and heavy.

    For the price, it’s not a bad deal, but there are a couple of things worth mentioning. The blade seems to lose its sharpness pretty quickly compared to other knives I’ve used. It worked great at first, but after a relatively short period of regular use, I noticed it wasn’t cutting as smoothly anymore.

    The other issue is rust. I put it in the dishwasher a few times, and it started showing signs of rust much sooner than I expected. If you buy this, I’d definitely recommend hand washing and drying it right away to help prevent that.

    That said, considering the cost, I still think it’s a decent value. It gets the job done and is reasonably priced, but don’t expect premium durability or long-lasting edge retention. Overall, good for the money, just be prepared for a little extra maintenance.

About this Item

  • ULTRA-SHARP PRECISION CUTTING: Forged from high-carbon stainless steel, these blades maintain a razor-sharp edge longer than standard steel. Perfect for precise slicing, dicing, and chopping, ensuring professional-grade results for every meal prep
  • ERGONOMIC COMFORT & BALANCE: Each knife is designed with a satin-finish ergonomic handle that fits securely in your hand, reducing fatigue. Perfectly weighted for balance and control, making it the best knife set for heavy-duty kitchen tasks.
  • ESSENTIAL 15-PIECE VERSATILITY: Includes an 8-inch chef knife, bread knife, santoku, and six steak knives. This comprehensive collection provides the specific tool needed for every culinary challenge, from trimming meat to slicing crusty bread
  • SPACE-SAVING ORGANIZATION: The included black pinewood block keeps your cutlery organized and protected. Ideal for new beginnings, college apartments, or wedding registries, this set combines high-performance tools with a modern aesthetic
  • DURABILITY & LONG-LASTING QUALITY: Farberware is the #1 selling cutlery brand in the U.S. for a reason. These knives are built to last; simply hand wash and dry to maintain the integrity of the high-carbon steel for a lifetime of reliable use.

Product Description

Professional Performance for the Home Chef

The Farberware 15-Piece High-Carbon Stainless Steel Kitchen Knife Set is the premium solution for home cooks seeking professional-level performance and durability. This comprehensive collection is designed to provide a perfect balance of variety and sharpness for every kitchen task. Each blade is expertly stamped from high-carbon steel—a material preferred for its ability to hold a sharper edge through repetitive, heavy-duty tasks like trimming meat, mincing garlic, or precision vegetable work.

Versatility for Every Culinary Challenge

Beyond the professional-grade blades, this set serves as a complete culinary starter kit. Whether you are setting up your first kitchen, looking for a thoughtful housewarming gift, or upgrading a mismatched collection, this 15-piece set covers every base. The collection features specialized tools including an 8-inch chef knife, bread knife, 4.5-inch Santoku, and six serrated steak knives for family dinners. Every tool is designed with a satin-finish ergonomic handle that fits securely in your hand, providing a comfortable, non-slip grip that reduces fatigue and ensures safety during long prep sessions.

Designed for Longevity and Organization

Modern kitchen organization is simplified with the included black pinewood block, which keeps your cutlery protected and organized while adding a modern aesthetic to your countertop. This makes it an ideal choice for wedding registries, college apartments, or new beginnings. As the #1 selling cutlery brand in the U.S., Farberware builds these knives to last; simply hand wash and dry to maintain the integrity of the high-carbon steel for a lifetime of reliable use. This set combines high-performance tools with functional design to ensure a high-quality experience for any home cook.
